newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FT Holdings says share offer 7.48 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: FT Holdings says share offer 7.48 times subscribed.

text.p: Christmas tree manufacturer FT Holdings International Ltd said on Saturday its initial public offer of 57.5 million shares at HK$1.00 per share was about 7.48 times subscribed.
The issue, managed by CEF Capital Ltd and Tai Fook Securities Co Ltd, received applications for 387.32 million shares, the company said in a statement.
It earlier said the issue would raise HK$42 million, and HK$15 million would be used to set up a joint venture in northern China to manufacture floral products.
Some HK$10 million would be used to expand production facilities in its manufacturing plant in Dongguan, Guangdong province, and HK$17 million would serve as working capital.
Dealing in the shares begin on January 3.
